deviations.description: Network ignores rule A: when the coverage goal exceeds the hot-spot cap (cov > cap) and no other rule (mandible-in-PTV, cord floor, missing structure) applies, it sends the request to automated planning instead of escalating.
deviations.condition: (cov - cap > 0.3) and (missing == 0) and (cord_lim - cord_floor > 0.3) and not ((mand_in_ptv - 0.05 * ptv_vol > -0.2) and (cov > mand_lim - 0.3))
